title: The Share of Recovered Fees Charged to a ShieldCare Premium Settlement
content:
## The share

Of the fees taken with a premium settlement on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan, the share
charged to the settlement is fixed by two things: the number of periods the arrears covers, and the
number of fees standing billed on the plan inside the last 12 months.

**The periods the arrears covers** are the premium instalments billed on the plan less the premium
payments received against it, divided by the plan's monthly premium and counted as whole periods.

| What the records show | The share charged of the fees taken |
| --- | --- |
| the arrears covers no more than 4 periods, and no more than 1 fee stands billed on the plan inside the last 12 months | the whole of the fees taken, being 100 percent of them |
| no more than 1 fee stands billed on the plan inside the last 12 months, and the arrears covers more than 4 periods | half of the fees taken, being 50 percent of them |
| every other plan | none of them is charged |

### Both sides of each threshold

An arrears covering exactly 4 periods is no more than 4 and reaches the whole of the fees; an arrears
covering 5 periods is more than 4 and reaches half of them. Exactly 1 fee inside the last 12 months
is no more than 1 and keeps the plan in one of the first two rows; 2 fees inside that year puts it in
the third, where none of the fees taken is charged.

### The combinations set out

| Periods the arrears covers | Fees billed inside the last 12 months | Share charged |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | 2 | none |
| 6 | 3 | none |
| 6 | 1 | 50 percent |
| 7 | 0 | 50 percent |
| 2 | 1 | 100 percent |
| 3 | 0 | 100 percent |
